text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in first paragraph","quality":"focus","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps the essay directed toward that claim."},{"evidence":"two developed body paragraphs with reasons and evidence","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more essay-like structure that separates ideas into body sections and builds them step by step."},{"evidence":"quotation about cars not being completely driverless","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses specific details from the article to back up its claims rather than staying general."},{"evidence":"explains why \"human skills\" matter and why that defeats the purpose","quality":"reasoning","description":"It connects evidence to the argument with clearer explanation instead of just mentioning facts."},{"evidence":"discussion of who is at fault in an accident","quality":"argument development","description":"It elaborates on a counterargument-like concern and shows how that issue supports the writer's position."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the main claims","quality":"closure","description":"It ends by summarizing the argument and reinforcing the position in a more complete way."}]}
